messages:
sam: Heads-up: customer VelocityApps reported a big uptick in generator p99 latency after last night's runtime push. p95 went from ~150ms -> 430ms, p99 from ~380ms -> 1.1s. They hit some 5xx timeouts. Any idea?
taylor: saw anomaly in canary dashboards around 03:20 UTC. kernel-level traces show flash_attn kernels ballooning for mid-range seqs. ci-bot: Canary 2028-06-20T03:22:10Z metrics: gen.p95=0.43s gen.p99=1.12s baseline.p99=0.39s.
anya: which model/pool?
sam: model: redwood-gpt-mini-q4 on pool-gpu-b. Config snapshot: FLASH_ATTENTION=on, SDPA=auto, batch_target=6, kvcache=true. VelocityApps sent this curl: 
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -d '{"model":"redwood-gpt-mini-q4","input":"explain: ...","max_tokens":200}'
```
rohit: I ran quick repro on a dev node (A100) with seq_len=320 batch=6 and reproduced p99 ~1.05s. Forcing SDPA for the same workload drops p99 to ~360ms.
taylor: interesting. Any recent compile or submodule changes?
anya: PR 4312 tweaked build flags: ENABLE_FLASH_VECTORIZATION=1 and bumped flashattn -> v2.15. Also we updated PTX flags (-Xptxas -dlcm) last week.
sam: can we do a fast mitigation: tenant-level kernel override to prefer sdpa for VelocityApps?
rohit: yep I can push override: `rctl tenant set velocityapps runtime.kernel=sdpa` and canary it.
ci-bot: Tenant override applied to prod-canary at 03:45 UTC. Monitoring window 20m.
rohit: after override canary snapshot: p99 dropped to 0.37s for affected traffic. VelocityApps confirmed improved responsiveness. :thumbsup: 
taylor: great. For root cause we should bisect: revert vectorization flag vs revert flashattn update. Anya can you build a non-vectorized debug runtime?
anya: building runtime without ENABLE_FLASH_VECTORIZATION now (debug build). ETA ~2h for microbench results.
sam: in parallel, lets add a temporary selector rule: prefer sdpa when seq_len in [256,384] for q4 models. That avoids tenant overrides and is quick to roll.
anya: I pushed selector patch to canary. Selector-canary metrics: affected p99 = 0.39s, global regressions = none observed.
taylor: ok plan: 1) selector heuristic -> canary -> prod (short-term) 2) backfill debug build to verify vect flag impact (mid-term) 3) if vect flag confirmed, either revert flag or coordinate upstream flashattn fix (long-term).
rohit: opened ticket PERF-7722 with trace logs, builds, and repro steps.
sam: notify support and the customer about mitigation and ask them to monitor.
support: VelocityApps says pages look normal now, will report if anything recurs.
taylor: thanks team. Follow-ups: anya keep us posted on build bench; rohit keep tenant override in place until selector is in prod; anya/jira owner track upstream flashattn. Closing when selector hits prod and ticket has next-step assigned.
